title: Instinct made AI agents worth the risk — and exposed the cost
teaser: Instinct is an invitation-only AI agent that works through iMessage and WhatsApp, connects to email, calendars and messaging apps, and acts on a user’s behalf. Its February closed beta has already made it popular around the San Francisco Bay Area, while the company reportedly discusses raising another $1 billion after receiving $350 million at a valuation that could reach $10 billion. The appeal is simple: unlike a blank chatbot, Instinct suggests actions. The risk is equally simple: those actions can affect flights, restaurant accounts, inboxes and money.
